title: Most games played
query:
select games
from match_participants
group by player
order by games desc
limit 6
render bar_chart with (y = games)

title: Weekly game volume
query:
select games
from match_participants
group by week
order by week asc
render line_chart with (y = games, x_axis = "Week", smooth = true)

title: Weekly game volume
query:
select games
from match_participants
group by week
order by week asc
render area_chart with (y = games, x_axis = "Week", smooth = true)

title: Weekly wins and losses
query:
select wins, losses
from match_participants
group by week
order by week asc
render stacked_bar with (y = (wins, losses))

title: Queue mix
query:
select games
from match_participants
group by queue
order by games desc
render donut_chart with (y = games)

title: Damage against KDA
query:
select damage_to_champions, kda, games
from match_participants
group by player
render scatter_chart with (x = damage_to_champions, y = kda, size = games)

title: Champion win rate by position
query:
select win_rate
from match_participants
group by champion, team_position
render heatmap with (value = win_rate, series = team_position, palette = gold)

title: Combat profile
query:
select win_rate, kda, cs_per_minute, vision_score, damage_to_champions
from match_participants
group by player
limit 3
render radar_chart with (y = (win_rate, kda, cs_per_minute, vision_score, damage_to_champions))

title: Server snapshot
query:
select games, win_rate, kda, avg_game_duration
from match_participants
group by all
render kpi_card with (y = (games, win_rate, kda, avg_game_duration))
